title: Fed Holds Rates But Multifamily Sellers Are Cracking: What the 2025 Financing Stalemate Means for Off-Market Deal Flow
intro: The Federal Reserve held its benchmark rate steady again in 2025, and for most of the financial press that is a story about inflation patience and monetary policy credibility. For a specific class of multifamily property owner, it is something closer to a deadline. Loans originated in 2021 and 2022
